environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with a custom rule group 'gql-injection-guard' that inspects POST body JSON payloads to /api/graphql and /api/search for nested fragment cycles, union-based field expansion beyond 3 levels, and string interpolation escape sequences in filter arguments (specifically: unbalanced quotes, closing braces followed by new query blocks). Additionally, the CloudFront distribution serving the dashboard page enforces Content-Security-Policy response headers with 'require-sri-for script' directive AND the origin response includes 'Content-Security-Policy: require-sri-for script; script-src https://cdn.example.com' which means any tampered CDN script that doesn't match the integrity hash will be blocked by the browser. The WAF rule uses a regex pattern set matching '\"\s*\)\s*\{' and '\}\s*\{\s*(query|mutation|subscription)' in the request body with action BLOCK, combined with a rate-based rule of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP to the /api/ path prefix.

config.cdn: CloudFront with Lambda@Edge adding CSP headers on viewer-response, SRI enforced
config.graphql_backend: Hasura v2.28 with admin secret, introspection enabled, no query depth limit
